title: repro compare's eval_passed counts the pre-research verdict, so research cannot raise it and pick ranks on it
goal: repro compare scores the frozen set so that research which answers a question raises the instance's figure: eval_passed (which repro pick ranks first) no longer requires the pack's verdict to equal repro_bench.csv's expect_verdict, which records the kb before research (63 absent rows want none, 10 partial rows want weak); the regex and found checks, or a verdict at least as good as expected, decide a pass. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S2).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b);sys.exit(1 if "['ok']" in s or '["ok"]' in s else 0)

repro_reason: the figure only moves on a real research run's instances; the code reads the eval row's ok, which includes the verdict
notes: ST-zvooqvlt, repro compare --record of record 2170d88 (2026-10-15): eval_passed is 24, 22 and 24 of 103 for instances 1, 2, 3 while good verdicts are 80, 79, 79 of 103. 63 of the 103 frozen rows expect none, so research that answers them cannot raise the figure; podman RB-podman-5 (expect weak) passes in instance 1 (weak) and fails in instances 2 and 3 (good). kb/_self/reports/research-repro.md section 6 names this.
